item.title: Conformal Invariance of the Conductivity Equation
item.description: In two dimensions the Conductivity Equation is invariant under conformal maps.

item.title: Boundary Mass and Stiffness Matrices
item.description: Boundary data (voltages f, currents g) are functions on \partial\Omega.

item.title: Galerkin Method
item.description: A Galerkin method approximates a variational problem \text{find } u\in V:\quad a(u,v) = \ell(v)\quad\forall v\in V by replacing the infinite-dimensional space V with a finite-dimensional subspace V_h = \operatorname{span}\{\varphi_1,\dots,\varphi_n\}.

item.title: Lagrange Finite Elements
item.description: Lagrange elements use piecewise polynomial basis functions defined by their values at nodes.

item.title: Mass Matrix
item.description: The mass matrix is the Gram matrix of the basis in L^2(\Omega): M_{ij} = \int_\Omega\varphi_i\,\varphi_j\,\mathrm dx .

item.title: Pixel Images and Finite Element Functions
item.description: Learned priors, image denoisers and plots work with pixel images, while the forward problem works with finite element coefficients.

item.title: Fast Solvers on Disk Domains
item.description: On a disk, the constant-coefficient Neumann problem separates in polar coordinates: Fourier modes in the angle, and one ordinary differential equation along the radius per mode.
